# AI Image Captioning with BLIP and Gradio

This project implements an AI-powered image captioning tool using the BLIP (Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training) model from Salesforce, exposed via a user-friendly web interface built with Gradio.

## ✨ Features

*   **Image Captioning**: Upload an image and get a descriptive text caption generated by the BLIP model.
*   **Easy-to-Use Interface**: A simple drag-and-drop or file selection interface powered by Gradio.
*   **Leverages Transformers**: Utilizes the powerful `transformers` library for model handling.

## 🚀 How to Run

This project is designed to be easily run in a Google Colab environment. Follow these steps:

1.  **Open in Google Colab**: Click on the following badge (or navigate to your `.ipynb` file in Colab).

    [![Open In Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/Manish-077/genai-captioning/blob/main/your_notebook_name.ipynb) 
    *(Replace `your_notebook_name.ipynb` with the actual name of your notebook file in the repo.)*

2.  **Install Dependencies**: Run the first code cell in the Colab notebook to install all necessary libraries:

    ```python
    !pip install numpy pandas pillow tensorflow torch torchvision transformers gradio
    ```

3.  **Load Model and Processor**: Execute the subsequent cells to load the `BlipProcessor` and `BlipForConditionalGeneration` model.

4.  **Define Caption Generation Function**: Run the cell containing the `generate_caption` function.

5.  **Launch Gradio Interface**: Finally, run the last two cells to initialize and launch the Gradio interface:

    ```python
    import gradio as gr
    # ... other code ...
    iface = gr.Interface(
        fn = generate_caption,
        inputs = gr.Image(type="filepath"),
        outputs = gr.Textbox(label = "Generated Caption"),
        title = "AI Image Captioning ",
        description = "Upload an image and get a caption generated by BLIP."
    )
    if __name__ == "__main__":
        iface.launch(share=True)
    ```

    After running the `iface.launch(share=True)` cell, a public URL will be generated. Click on this URL to open the Gradio web interface in your browser.

## 📸 Usage

Once the Gradio interface is running:

1.  **Upload an Image**: Drag and drop an image into the designated area or click to browse for a file.
2.  **View Caption**: The generated caption will appear in the "Generated Caption" textbox.
